ValidationRule.description: DIR-763: When a discount is applied (Discount > 0), a Quote can only move to Customer Approved after the DOA approval was Approved (prior status must be Approved).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Customer Approved"), Discount > 0, NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Approved")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Quote has a discount applied, so it must be approved through the discount approval process before it can be set to Customer Approved.
